description: Investigate Penn B2963 / Montgomery 3 Date Made: ca. 200 BCE. The value is preserved as a museum-reported claim, not accepted as a corrected chronology. Check primary catalogue dating and later scholarship; do not infer a replacement date.
resolution_notes: Montgomery section 14, printed pp. 103–105 (PDF pp. 109–111), was visually reviewed on 2026-09-05. It places the Nippur bowl cohort in the late pre-Islamic period, no later than the sixth or beginning of the seventh century, with an archaeological terminus ad quem near 600 CE. This contextual claim is now stored separately as dating_context for text 3; it is not an object-specific date and does not replace Penn's ca. 200 BCE. Later object-specific scholarship still needs review.
